# AndroJack MCP

> AndroJack MCP is a read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 23 tools
> for AI-assisted Android development. It grounds answers in official Android and
> Kotlin documentation and enforces 34 Android validation rules on generated code,
> both inside the AI assistant and in CI.

## What it does

- Validates AI-generated Kotlin, XML, and Gradle code against 34 Android rules
  (removed and deprecated APIs, Android 16/17 behaviour changes, Compose-first,
  KSP over kapt), with PASS/WARN/FAIL verdicts and structured output
- Runs the same rules in CI: `npx androjack-mcp validate --format=sarif`
- Retrieves official documentation (Google's Developer Knowledge API with an
  optional key, or a verified index of developer.android.com / kotlinlang.org pages)
- Looks up current library versions from Google Maven and Maven Central
- Covers Android 17 / API 37, Play target-API requirements, developer verification,
  Navigation 3, Material 3 Expressive, large screens, KMP and Room 3, Wear OS, XR,
  on-device AI and AppFunctions
- Distributed as an npm package and a VS Code extension
- Works with any MCP client: Claude, Cursor, VS Code / Copilot, Windsurf, Kiro,
  Android Studio, Antigravity

## Who it's for

Android developers using AI coding assistants who want reliable,
documentation-backed code — not hallucinated or deprecated APIs.

## Installation

### npm (MCP server)
```
npm install -g androjack-mcp@2.1.0
```
or run without installing: `npx androjack-mcp@2.1.0 install`

### VS Code Extension
Search `AndroJack MCP` in the VS Code Extensions panel,
or install via: `ext install vikas9793.androjack-vscode@2.1.0`

### CI
```
npx androjack-mcp@2.1.0 validate . --target-sdk=37 --format=sarif
```
